unresolved.question: This page's legend defines ২ as ইখফা (letter legend: ক কলকলাহ, শ শিষ, গ গুন্নাহ, ম মোটা, ∧ আরবী সাকিন; no digit legend for ১/৩/৪/৬ is printed); ২ labelled ইখফা (over nun sakin in انْفَطَرَتْ, انْتَثَرَتْ, الْاِنْسَانُ, لِمَنْ, مِنْكُمْ and the tanween of كِرَامًا); default labels used for the other digits.
Row 7: فَسَوّٰكَ is printed with shadda and standing alif on the waw and no visible ى tooth before the ك; transcribed as printed.
Final ya printed dotless in عَلَى, الَّذِىْ, فِىْۤ, لَفِىْ and written as U+0649; the mark over فِىْۤ is a ∧ with a bar on top, encoded as sukun plus small high madda (U+06E4).
Header bengali name printed as 'সূরা ইংফিত্ব-র' (also in the footer); header box prints no Arabic surah name.
Where two band signs are printed together over one word (শম over ص of صَاحِبُكُمْ, ১ম over شَيْطٰنٍ and اللّٰهِ), both are anchored to the same letter cluster.
